topics.label: Introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture within the cancer course and sets out its learning objectives.

topics.label: Genetic origins and clonal evolution of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations arise and enable susceptible cells to evolve into cancer within a permissive microenvironment.

topics.label: Environmental influences on cancer risk
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the contribution of environmental exposure to cancer risk and how evidence for that contribution should be interpreted.

topics.label: Infectious causes of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how infections contribute to carcinogenesis, using Burkitt lymphoma as a detailed example.

topics.label: Mechanisms of environmental DNA damage
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how environmental carcinogens produce DNA damage that can become cancer-driving mutations.

topics.label: Tumour initiation and promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish why mutational initiation may require a subsequent growth-promoting environment for tumours to develop.

topics.label: Carcinogen specificity and biological susceptibility
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how biological context determines susceptibility to carcinogens and conclude with a recap of the mechanisms discussed.

topics.label: Human evidence linking carcinogen exposure to cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics show how evidence from human samples and populations can link particular exposures to cancer.

topics.label: Experimental carcinogenicity testing and its limitations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how controlled experimental tests assess carcinogenic potential and why their results may not fully predict human cancer risk.

topics.label: Closing summary and risk–benefit decisions
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture by summarising its conclusions and placing cancer risks within everyday risk–benefit decisions.
